sources.jaw_travel: User confirmed 50 mm per jaw from open to closed.

limitations: Motor torque is already specified at the geared output; do not multiply by the internal reduction again.
7 Nm peak is recorded only; the simulation drive is capped at 3 Nm without a duty or thermal model.
Rack/pinion constraints are ideal and lossless; actual grip force, friction and backlash are uncalibrated.
The mechanism mass of 160 g is a carried-over estimate, not a measurement of this new gripper.
Motor body uses the existing RS00-named CAD envelope pending DM4310 geometry verification.
Motor rotor inertia is unavailable; no invented reflected rotor armature is assigned.
Position gain follows the upstream reference; damping is tuned to 0.05 Nm s/rad for simulation, not measured hardware tuning.

No-load speed is recorded as a reference. Position commands are rate-limited; hard joint-velocity constraints are disabled because they distort contact forces. A measured torque-speed curve is unavailable.
